# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `freshbooks` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.freshbooks.com/v1`.
- Auth uses OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration against `auth.freshbooks.com` — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: FreshBooks' official mark, from the `freshbooks` GitHub organization.
